unlisted_practices: Use the RE-AIM framework (Reach, Efficacy, Adoption, Implementation, Maintenance) to evaluate implementation of predictive tools
Engage a wide range of clinical users from the start of a predictive analytics project
Collect clinician feedback on an ongoing basis

screen.reason: This is a qualitative empirical study evaluating clinician barriers and facilitators using the RE-AIM framework following the real-world clinical implementation of a machine learning-based discharge prediction tool.
